quote.text: Let death and exile and every other thing which appears dreadful be daily before your eyes; but most of all death: and you will never think of anything mean nor will you desire anything extravagantly.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace the inevitability of life's impermanence to cherish every moment with your children, ensuring that each day is filled with mindful presence.
    • Let the awareness of life's transient nature instill humility and patience, guiding you to nurture, teach, and lead by example without succumbing to trivial grievances.
  • Leadership
    • Reflect on the mirror of mortality to remind yourself that no power or status is eternal; genuine leadership lies in service and ethical stewardship.
    • Understanding that even challenges and setbacks are fleeting enables you to lead with calm resilience, making decisions that are thoughtful, balanced, and grounded in reality.
  • Product Management
    • Recognize that every feature and initiative has its moment; by keeping the finite nature of time in mind, you can focus on delivering value instead of chasing extravagant promises.
    • Adopt a mindset that values simplicity and pragmatism—just as death reminds us of life’s brevity, let it guide you to streamline processes and prioritize what truly matters in the product lifecycle.
